user_signal.goal_or_constraint: System maintenance must not merely obey the latest user example or patch the latest symptom. It needs a default full reflection path that explicitly learns when warranted, assimilates user corrections without blindly canonizing proposed mechanisms, decides whether GPT/account/startup instructions must change, checks cross-subsystem inheritance, attacks bloat and efficiency cost, and calibrates closure so the user does not have to repeatedly enumerate missing dimensions.
user_signal.proposed_mechanism: Consider a higher-level system/agent and stronger distillation/learning tooling rather than continuing to extend the old maintenance path by habit.
user_signal.counterexample: Previous maintenance passes repeatedly became green and were described as internally complete, after which the user exposed another omitted review dimension such as artifact applicability, true execution proof, new-owner cold start, full-system audit, or meta-level learning/instruction/inheritance/efficiency review.

failure_classes: repair-first governance: the default maintenance loop emphasized diagnose/patch/validate before explicitly requiring full-system impact, learning, instruction-surface, inheritance and efficiency review
self-review without a process verifier: the same maintenance actor could decide which review dimensions mattered and then declare closure

user-correction assimilation gap: user corrections were treated as triggers but the system did not force first-occurrence classification into goal/counterexample/proposed mechanism and a broader impact review
instruction-surface omission: there was no mandatory decision explaining whether account/startup instructions should change or why they should not
cross-subsystem inheritance blind spot: compatible semantics-owner changes could be assumed to propagate without a mandatory registry-derived owner/override scan
complexity-efficiency blindness: reliability additions were not required to account for startup context, tool/remote reads, steady-state latency, duplicate rules or migration burden
premature global closure language: a scoped green maintenance pass could be rhetorically generalized beyond its evidence ceiling

sources.observation: Agent execution should expose traces/observability so evaluation can inspect what actually happened rather than infer execution from declarations.
sources.rationale: Directly addresses this system's recurring declaration/receipt/self-report gaps; supports keeping execution traces and evaluators distinct.

sources.observation: Workflow evaluation uses graders/datasets and trace-level evidence to detect workflow failures across iterations.
sources.rationale: Supports regression/held-out evaluation as a maintenance closure input rather than relying on self-review.

sources.observation: Agent teams should build evals early and use them to replace reactive production issue loops with measurable development feedback.
sources.rationale: Matches the observed operator-dependence failure where the user repeatedly supplied the next missing counterexample.

sources.observation: Long-running agents need harness-level durable state, explicit progress artifacts and incremental validation across context windows.
sources.rationale: Supports making the meta-maintenance run a durable machine-readable object instead of a chat-only reflection.

sources.observation: Reusable procedures benefit from progressive disclosure and on-demand loading rather than permanently expanding the base prompt.
sources.rationale: Supports keeping meta-maintenance cold-path and avoiding a giant Custom Instructions or owner-prompt copy.

sources.observation: A small harness can serialize the full trajectory, enforce step/cost/time limits and keep action/observation flow explicit without a large orchestration hierarchy.
sources.rationale: Supports a narrow deterministic Meta-Governance Harness rather than another personality-style supervisory Agent.

sources.observation: GEPA evolves prompts/code/agent architectures by executing candidates against an evaluator, reading traces, reflecting, mutating and selecting on train/validation evidence.
sources.rationale: Useful later for prompt/skill optimization when a trustworthy metric and held-out dataset exist; not admitted as meta-architecture authority because the current governance-quality metric is not mature enough and automated optimization would risk Goodhart/overfit.

sources.observation: Prompt optimization is evaluation-driven and optimized prompts must be re-evaluated/manual-reviewed because optimization can regress some inputs.
sources.rationale: Adopt the eval-before/after discipline, but do not make a prompt optimizer a core dependency or use prompt growth to mask runtime/governance defects.

alternatives.rationale: Necessary as normative semantics but insufficient alone: the maintenance actor could still skip dimensions and self-report completion without a separate structural closure check.

A new supervisory Agent without a distinct executor identity, trace and measurable independent lift would add coordination/context cost and could become another role-played self-review layer. Reconsider only if a genuinely separate executor/verifier path exists and held-out evaluation shows benefit.

Keep SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY as the normative owner, add a narrow deterministic harness that rejects missing learning/user-signal/instruction/propagation/complexity/second-order/closure evidence, and retain independent trajectory graders for semantic assurance. This creates a real upper verification layer without creating a parallel business authority or fake independent Agent.

instruction_surface.reason: Internal ENTRYPOINT maintenance routing needs one minimal trigger sentence and its stale receipt-contract 1.2 wording must align to 1.3. The external ChatGPT account/Custom Instructions do not currently need a larger doctrine block: STARTUP_HOOK already routes system maintenance to current repository authority, and this live conversation demonstrates the maintenance route can be entered. Adding the full meta-governance method to account instructions would duplicate authority and increase prompt bloat. Repository writes are not treated as proof of account-instruction propagation; request an external account edit only if future product evidence shows this class of signal fails to route.

propagation.mechanism: SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY remains the operational_hygiene semantics owner and is referenced by current owner adapters; evolution semantics remain in CONTINUOUS_LEARNING_POLICY. Compatible semantics hardening propagates through existing exact-version profile bindings and event-driven loading rather than copied owner prose or a profile-version bump.
override_scan_evidence: Financial/A-share/Novel/Video adapters all bind artifact_io@1.0 + operational_hygiene@1.0 + evolution@1.0
owner overrides inspected are evaluator/artifact specializations and do not replace the shared maintenance evidence/reliability/authority invariants
OWNER_ADAPTER_CONTRACT versioning rule explicitly permits compatible semantics-owner improvements without forcing profile-version changes

complexity_efficiency.tool_or_remote_read_delta: Additional learning/owner-impact reads only on systemic or architecture maintenance; local deterministic fixes may record NOT_REQUIRED_WITH_REASON; ordinary business turns unchanged.
complexity_efficiency.duplicate_rule_effect: CONSOLIDATE: keep SYSTEM_MAINTENANCE_POLICY as one semantics owner; Meta-Governance Harness is an executable verifier, not a second root policy; do not copy the method into owner prompts or account instructions.
complexity_efficiency.test_observability_effect: Adds deterministic meta-maintenance process-conformance tests and a machine-readable run record; semantic independence still uses existing trajectory/evidence-verifier gates.

superseded_or_demoted_surfaces: The previous repair-first maintenance-loop interpretation is superseded by the explicit meta-maintenance outline for systemic/non-trivial work.
The assumption that a green self-audit process can itself establish semantic independence is rejected; deterministic harness assurance is structurally bounded.

regression_or_eval_refs: GitHub Actions run 38077001860 at head 7e902847427a624bbc60fcbfb25f732b70781f78: risk-tiered control-plane audit PASS and full pytest PASS
second_order_findings: The same maintenance actor can still fill a structurally valid run record after the fact; the harness cannot prove chronology or semantic truth.
Therefore a Meta-Governance Harness PASS is STRUCTURED_PROCESS_CONFORMANCE_ONLY and must not be called independent evaluation.

Full-depth review on every business/local fix would be bureaucratic and slow; full learning/impact/inheritance/complexity review is limited to systemic/non-trivial maintenance while local deterministic fixes may use explicit NOT_REQUIRED_WITH_REASON.
A new LLM meta-agent is not admitted without a distinct executor/trace and held-out measured lift; role names alone would recreate self-attestation inflation.
Prompt/skill optimizers such as GEPA are not architecture authority; they require trustworthy metrics/train-heldout data and remain optional until such an eval surface exists.
The current design adds no root authority and no steady-state business preload; it adds a cold-path runtime verifier and tests.

It proves only the covered governance process and regressions; future unknowns must enter the same evidence/eval loop.
